meta.title: Gemini 增强
meta.description: When enabled in Plugins, translates known DSH system prompt sections into Simplified Chinese on steps whose model ID matches the configured rules, regardless of provider. The Web UI lets you edit one exact model ID or trailing-* rule per line; defaults are gemini-4, gemini-4-*, and gemini-4.*. An optional composer notice for confirmed localization is off by default. Custom instructions and tool schemas stay unchanged. Makes no extra model calls and does not change routing or add search. Disable the plugin to stop localizing future steps.
